props.name: series
props.description: Bars, lines, areas and dots, each with its `type`; `yAxis: "right"` plots a series against `yAxis2`

props.name: stackMode
props.description: `percent` scales every stack to 100% at each x

props.name: yAxis2
props.description: Right value axis of the series with `yAxis: "right"`; its range is aligned on the left ticks (vertical charts)

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` puts the x axis (categories) down the left side and the values along the bottom

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: xAxis
props.description: X axis

props.name: yAxis
props.description: Y axis

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the data layer: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: crosshair
props.description: Vertical guide line following the pointer

props.name: annotations
props.description: Background areas and reference lines

props.name: interaction
props.description: Zoom (Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, pinch), pan (drag), double-click reset and keyboard navigation; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, compact units `k` / `万`, separators, month and weekday names of time axes)

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) points change

events.name: onPointClick
events.description: Called when a point (or bar) is clicked

events.name: onPlotClick
events.description: Called when the plot area is clicked where there is no point

events.name: onZoom
events.description: Called when the user zooms or pans

events.name: onRendererChange
events.description: Called with the backend once it is ready (and when it falls back after a GPU loss)

examples.title: Sprint burndown
examples.description: The remaining work as an area, the points completed each day as bars and the ideal burn as a line on explicit xAxis categories; a text annotation flags a scope change. renderTooltip tells how far ahead or behind the ideal line each day is.

examples.title: Climate chart
examples.description: Rainfall bars on the left axis and the temperature curve on the right axis; zero: true keeps zero in the right range.

examples.title: Traffic and conversion
examples.description: An area of daily sessions with the conversion rate on the right axis and a campaign highlighted by a rect annotation.

examples.title: Inventory and deliveries
examples.description: A stepped area of the stock level with delivery bars, a reorder point line and a safety stock rect. onPointClick marks the day with an x line and shows its purchase order or stock in an output; onPlotClick clears it.

examples.title: Locales
examples.description: The same chart with locale="zh-CN" and locale="fr-FR": the engine writes the compact units (万 / k), the separators, the month names of the time axis and the tooltip dates of the locale. Without locale, charts follow the page language (<html lang>).

examples.title: Log scale
examples.description: Users grow 6,000-fold in ten years: yAxis2={{ type: "log" }} draws them on a logarithmic right axis with its own decades, next to the revenue bars on the linear left axis; tooltips keep the actual values.

examples.title: Operations overview
examples.description: Request bars on the left axis, the error rate on the right axis, and the releases as a type: "scatter" series whose showLabels writes each version. Checkboxes replace the legend and set hidden on each series.

examples.title: Pareto chart
examples.description: Sorted causes with their cumulative share on a 0-100% right axis (min, max and nice: false); the causes behind 80% of the returns are highlighted.

examples.title: Revenue and growth
examples.description: The growth line sets yAxis: "right" and is drawn against yAxis2 with its own format; the right range is aligned on the left ticks, so the grid fits both axes.

examples.title: Solar and home battery
examples.description: Hourly solar production as bars and consumption as a line on the left axis, the battery's state of charge as an area on yAxis2 fixed to 0–100% with min, max and nice: false; rect annotations shade the nights. The Switch hides the battery and the output recomputes the self-sufficiency.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
